m: अप्वा (3; अप्वा, Naigh.) f. ‘Impurity’, N. of a deity presiding over evacuation from fright, RV. x, 103, 12 (voc. अप्वे), AV. ix, 8, 9 (acc. अप्वाम्).

v: tri॰ Apa--bA॰ va pf॰ hrasvaH । prApye “amIzAM cittaM pratiloBayantI gfhARyaNgAnyapveparehi” f॰ 10, 103, 12, “harimARaM te'NgeByo'pvAmantarodarAt” aTa॰ 9, 8, 9
m: अप्व mf(आ)n. abounding in water, MānGṛ.
a: अप्व — a. [आप् बाहु˚ व, पृषो˚ थस्वः] Attainable. --प्वा Disease, danger; the region of the throat or neck (?).
